subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Safest Cars Ever Tested
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Safest Cars Ever Tested.

hook.text: Some brands have built reputations entirely around one word—safety.

buildup.text: Volvo pledged in 2020 that no one would die in a new Volvo, setting a bold public goal.

discovery.text: Subaru's EyeSight system helped its cars achieve some of the lowest crash injury rates on record.

twist.text: The safest cars aren't always the priciest—several affordable models earn top scores.

climax.text: Tesla's Model 3 recorded the lowest probability of injury ever measured in NHTSA testing.

punchline.text: Safety leaders prove that protecting lives sells cars.

quiz.question: Which brand publicly pledged zero deaths in its new cars?
